author: Spoookeh
body:
Hello,

Recently I was in a teamspeak chat with a few others and someone by the name of 'kyurem' entered the chat. He started to be rude against players in Berzerk and seemed very 'salty' should I say the least about the tournament. This and a statement from steven5703 led me to believe he was DaGoldBrick (Steven's Statement: http://imgur.com/hYrbXCi)

I found this behaviour extremely unacceptable, it includes DDoS jokes, rudeness and overall immaturity/trolling. 

The other 2 players 'trolling' were Caiiden (already been punished before) and Atdit.

I hope some form of action is taken.

Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/lt6Be

replies.body:
Thank you for reporting, this user will receive a TeamSpeak punishment, most likely a lengthy tempban. The evidence you gave us was very helpful, and I encourage you to keep it up!

Thanks again,

-Spart/Magic
